successor_endpoint_policy: Only declare a separate finite 8000 endpoint when TRAIN evidence still improves; keep all prior endpoints and selection state

model.output: Bounded 3D delta, norm <= .004m; candidate parameterization, never GR00T clipping

features: Two real 256x256 RGB images: 4x4 RGB averages and visible-red pixel moments; actual EEF10; declared 2-way task instruction
labels: Only real submitted and solver/gripper-consumed full-reference delta; full safe trace and CLOSED0 required
selection: For each seed earliest minimum grouped DEV command MSE checkpoint; then smallest DEV error seed, ties lower seed. All seeds retained; model seeds are not independent physical repetitions.
baseline: Conditional TRAIN mean consumed delta using the same task instruction, no DEV fit
evaluation: Independent native candidate DEV panel must be frozen before dispatch. Command MSE is not native success; original strict approach or HOLD nonprogress predicates plus <=2mm TCP excursion.
deployment: Actual new target RGB + EEF + instruction; NumPy-only native inference; no teacher fallback
